title: Stability of Anomalous Dissipation for the Forced 3D Navier--Stokes Equations under Geometric Perturbations
summary: The energy dissipation in the inviscid limit is a central problem in turbulence theory. Kolmogorov's K41 theory predicts a positive dissipation rate independent of viscosity -- a phenomenon known as anomalous dissipation. Brué and De Lellis gave the first rigorous construction, but it relies on extremely precise geometric conditions. Based on quasi-self-similar mixing, we prove structural stability under pure normal perturbations of the central curves.
